title: Refuse invalid or unsupported sheet geometry
description: Validate normalized uniform-grid geometry and return structured, field-associated refusals for every invalid or unsupported condition without coercion, clamping, or hidden adjustment.
acceptanceCriteria: Negative and non-finite values are refused with named fields
Contradictory extents, overlapping labels, and labels outside the sheet are refused
Corner radius greater than half the smaller label dimension is refused
Non-uniform, non-rectangular, roll, continuous, duplex, circular, oval, arbitrary die-cut, or otherwise unsupported media are refused
No invalid input is saved through coercion, clamping, hidden rounding, or automatic correction
Refusals contain stable codes, affected fields, and actionable messages

steps.details: Create stable refusal codes and payloads for numeric, extent, overlap, bounds, radius, uniformity, and unsupported-media failures, including affected field paths.
Reject negative or non-finite dimensions and enforce radius less than or equal to half the smaller label dimension while preserving unknown radius as valid disclosure.
Compute each label boundary from normalized values and refuse contradictory totals, overlap, reversed extents, or any boundary outside sheet coordinates.

Keep the validator's supported-media discriminator closed to rectangular sheets with uniform axis-aligned square or rounded-rectangle grids and return explicit reasons for other shapes or feed models.
Render refusal summaries and field-level associations, disable or reject save while refusals exist, and retain the user's source text for correction.
Add contract fixtures for every refusal class and a browser scenario proving invalid geometry remains unsaved and visibly actionable.

technicalNotes: Do not use floating-point tolerance to excuse visibly contradictory geometry; document any comparison epsilon narrowly.
Refusal reasons are shared domain values for later compatibility and UI consistency.
